versions.changelog:
blueair-openclaw-skill v0.1.1

- Added compiled distribution files in the dist/ directory, supporting API clients and CLI scripts for device control and status.
- Updated scripts to use dist/ paths instead of scripts/dist/.
- Enhanced documentation in SKILL.md to specify required credentials and installation steps.
- Clarified instructions for running status and control commands.
- Improved metadata with fields for required credentials and setup steps.

- Initial release of blueair-expert for managing Blueair air purifiers and interpreting indoor air quality.
- Provides expert summary of household air, translating sensor data (PM2.5, VOC, etc.) into clear health recommendations.
- Supports device control (fan speed, mode changes, standby, child lock) via CLI scripts.
- Offers proactive suggestions based on air quality and user-reported discomfort.
- Guides setup if Blueair credentials are missing.
